text: FR-1: The system shall allow students to create, edit, and delete courses, deadlines, and available study time blocks.
label: functional

text: FR-2: The system shall generate a weekly study schedule based on deadlines, course priority, available hours, and user preferences.
label: functional

text: NFR-1: The system shall present generated schedules in a readable calendar view and allow students to manually revise suggested sessions.
label: usability

text: NFR-2: The system shall not expose student profile information, courses, deadlines, or study habits to unauthorized users.
label: privacy

text: SEC-1: The system shall require authentication before users can access personal project, schedule, or profile data.
label: security

text: SEC-2: The system shall validate all user inputs before storing or processing them to reduce injection and malformed input risks.
label: security
